benchmark.limitations: Bounded host diagnostics; no portable timing threshold, physical-device, GPU/Metal, thermal, resident-memory, sustained-FPS or UI-scheduling claim. Poll counts are not pixel-evaluation counts.
benchmark.n7Meaning: p50 is fourth ordered sample; p95 is seventh (maximum).

rawReport.fixtureDefinition: No random sampling or seed: fixed midpoint quadrature and stable fixture light UUIDs. Portrait recipe; camera (0,1.60,1.7)m, 85mm full-frame lens, 5600K white balance, +1.25 stops. Point3 uses recipe point emitters. Area3 replaces them with 1x1.2m, 0.8x0.8m and 0.4x0.8m rectangles, 8x8 samples each. Area12 repeats each area light four times at one quarter intensity for cancellation only.
rawReport.methodology: One warm-up per workload; monotonic wall time; nearest-rank p50/p95. Deterministic synchronous CPU renders. Cancellation uses monotonic deadlines in the real callback, not asynchronous UI scheduling. Receiver microbenchmarks omit image/color conversion and primary intersections. Short-run shared-host diagnostics, not physical-device, GPU, thermal, memory or sustained frame-rate evidence.

benchmark.repeatabilityEvidence: Pinned benchmark checks every measured StudyImage equals its warmup and has zero unsupported pixels before emitting JSON. Repeated raw images are not separately retained.
benchmark.warmupEvidence: Eight recorded frame warmup durations; pinned source performs one warmup for each frame and visibility workload.
